info.title: Stepclimb API
info.description: The public API every Stepclimb client uses. There are no private endpoints.

get.summary: Finish a sign-in with an outside identity provider.
get.description: A browser navigation: the provider's redirect back after sign-in, with `code` and `state` or with `error` and `state`. It needs the `__Host-sc_flow` cookie of the flow the start route began, and clears it. Every refusal is a 303 to `/sign-in?error=<code>`: `auth.provider_not_found` (no enabled provider with this key), `auth.flow_invalid` (no flow cookie, a used or unknown flow, a flow for another provider, or another `state`), `auth.flow_expired` (the flow is older than 10 minutes), `auth.provider_denied` (the person declined at the provider), `auth.provider_error` (the provider reported an error, or its token, key set or userinfo answer could not be used), `auth.id_token_invalid` (the ID token failed a check), `auth.subject_missing` (the ID token's `sub` or the OAuth 2 userinfo subject is missing, empty, holds NUL or is longer than 255 characters), the admission refusals `auth.suspended`, `auth.admission_refused`, `auth.signup_closed` and `entitlement.limit_reached`, or `auth.rate_limited` (with `Retry-After`). An admitted sign-in sets `__Host-sc_session` and is a 303 to the flow's `return_to`.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The provider's key in the organization (`identity_providers.key`).

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: The provider's error code, on failure.

parameters.name: error_description
parameters.description: The provider's description of the error. Logged, never shown.

303.description: To the flow's `return_to`, signed in, or to `/sign-in?error=<code>`

Location.description: The `return_to` path, or the sign-in page with the error code

Retry-After.description: With `auth.rate_limited`: seconds to wait, at least 1

Set-Cookie.description: Clears the `__Host-sc_flow` cookie; signed in, also sets `__Host-sc_session`

get.summary: Start a sign-in with an outside identity provider.
get.description: A browser navigation. Sends the browser to the provider's authorization endpoint with `state` and a PKCE S256 challenge (for an OIDC provider also a `nonce`; for an OAuth 2 provider whose `pkce` is off, no challenge), bound to the sign-in flow whose `__Host-sc_flow` cookie this answer sets. Every refusal is a 303 to `/sign-in?error=<code>`: `auth.provider_not_found` (no enabled provider with this key), `auth.provider_unavailable` (the provider's discovery document could not be read or names another issuer, its stored config does not read, or its authorization URL is refused by the outbound URL policy) or `auth.rate_limited` (with `Retry-After`).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The provider's key in the organization (`identity_providers.key`).

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description:
The path on this site to land on after sign-in. Anything but a safe path on this host
becomes `/`.

303.description: To the provider's authorization endpoint, or to `/sign-in?error=<code>`

Location.description: The authorization URL, or the sign-in page with the error code

Retry-After.description: With `auth.rate_limited`: seconds to wait, at least 1

Set-Cookie.description: To the provider: the `__Host-sc_flow` cookie of the sign-in flow

get.summary: The server process is running.
The server can take traffic: the database answered within two seconds.

503.description: The database did not answer in time

get.summary: The stylesheet of the request's organization: its saved branding's, or the default brand's.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description:
The stylesheet's SHA-256 (lowercase hex), as the served page links it. When it is the
served stylesheet's, the answer is cached for a year; otherwise it is revalidated on
every load.

200.description: The organization's light, dark and high-contrast themes as CSS variables: the default brand's when it has saved no branding or the instance has no organization yet. Cached for a year (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`) when `v` is the stylesheet's hash, as the page the server serves links it; revalidated on every load (`no-cache`) otherwise.

Account.description: An account of the caller's organization.

depth.description: 0 for the root, 1 for its children, and so on; at most 16.

parent_id.description: `null` for the root only. Shown even when the parent is not visible to the caller.

AccountMove.description: The new parent of a moved account.

parent_id.description:
The new parent; you must hold `account.manage` at a scope containing it. The account's
current parent changes nothing.

AccountPatch.description:
A change to an account; an omitted member is left as it is. A member sent as `null` is
malformed: omit it instead.

AdmissionAll.description: Holds when every one of its 1 to 50 rules holds. Groups nest at most 4 deep.

AdmissionAny.description: Holds when at least one of its 1 to 50 rules holds. Groups nest at most 4 deep.

AdmissionCondition.description:
A test of one mapped attribute. Rules see attributes exactly as the provider's claims map
them, verified or not: an attribute mapped from an email claim holds the address the
provider sent even when it did not vouch for it. To rely on such a value, map the
provider's verification claim as an attribute too and require it alongside, as in
`{"attribute": "email_verified", "op": "equals", "value": true}`.

attribute.description:
The attribute's name, as the provider's `claims.attributes` maps it; 1 to 1,000
characters.

oneOf.description:
`equals`: a string, integer or boolean. `in` and `not_in`: 1 to 100 of them, all of one
type. `matches`: a regular expression (Rust `regex` syntax, at most 1,000 characters),
matched against the whole value. `exists`: absent.

AdmissionOp.description: What a condition asks of its attribute.

AdmissionRule.description:
One admission rule: a condition on one mapped attribute, or a group of rules. An attribute
that is absent or `null` fails its condition, whatever the `op`; one of a type the rule
cannot compare refuses the sign-in.

AdmissionRules.description:
The rules every sign-in through an outside provider must pass (Q3 (a)): every rule of the
organization's list and of the provider's own list. A sign-in with a local account runs no
rules. A refused person is answered `auth.admission_refused`.

organization.description:
The rules every outside provider's sign-ins must pass. Their attributes must be ones
some provider maps; a provider that does not map one fails the rule.

providers.description:
Each outside provider of the organization, enabled or not, by key, with the rules its
sign-ins must pass besides the organization's; `[]` when it has none.

AdmissionRulesPatch.description:
The rule lists to replace: each list named replaces the stored one whole, and a list not
named keeps its rules. At most 50 rules per list.

providers.description: Provider lists by provider key; a provider not named keeps its list. `[]` empties one.

AdmissionScalar.description: One value of an `in` or `not_in` list.

signup_allowed.description:
Whether a person the organization has no user for is created as a user when they first
sign in through an identity provider. Off, they are refused with `auth.signup_closed`.

sync_only.description:
Whether only users already provisioned may sign in. This release accepts only `false`:
`true` answers 422 with `admission.sync_only_unavailable`.

AdmissionSettingsPatch.description:
A change to the admission switches and rules: send only what you change. An absent member
keeps its stored value, and `{}` changes nothing. A member sent as `null` is malformed: omit
it instead.

signup_allowed.description:
Whether a person the organization has no user for is created as a user when they first
sign in through an identity provider.

sync_only.description:
Whether only users already provisioned may sign in. This release accepts only `false`:
`true` answers 422 with `admission.sync_only_unavailable`.

AdmissionSwitches.description: The admission switches as the organization settings show them.

signup_allowed.description:
Whether a person the organization has no user for is created as a user when they first
sign in through an identity provider; `false` unless set. Off, they are refused with
`auth.signup_closed`.

sync_only.description: Whether only users already provisioned may sign in; `false` unless set.

AssignmentSource.description:
Who owns an assignment: an admin of this organization (`local`), or the identity provider,
sync API, SCIM or connector that wrote it, in which case it cannot be removed here.

userVerification.description: `required`: the authenticator checks a PIN or biometric.

Branding.description:
The organization's branding: the saved inputs (the default brand's when it has saved none),
the generator version, the hash of the stylesheet `/theme.css` serves, and the contrast
report of its light, dark and high-contrast themes.

css_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the stylesheet, lowercase hex.

generator.description: The version of the theme generator that wrote the stylesheet.

BrandingInputs.description:
The branding inputs. The whole set is replaced; an omitted or `null` choice takes its
default. A value that is not a choice is a 422, not a 400.

primary.description: The primary color: a CSS hex color (`#500E0E`, `#f00`) or `oklch(L C H)`, opaque.

report.description: On `branding.contrast_failed`, every appearance's report, failing pairs first.

BrandingProblem.description:
A problem details body with the contrast report: `branding.contrast_failed` carries
`report`, every other code leaves it out.

CodeRequired.description: A right password whose account also needs a TOTP code: no session exists yet.

next.description: Send the code to `POST /auth/local/totp` in this browser within 10 minutes.

minimum.description: 4.5 for text and 3 for other pairs; 7 and 4.5 in high contrast.

ratio.description: The WCAG 2 contrast ratio on the displayed 8-bit sRGB colors, 1 to 21, unrounded.

ContrastWarning.description:
Something to look at that does not fail the theme. `brand-near-danger`: the brand's hue is
within 30 degrees of `danger`'s.

CornerStyle.description: The corner style: `square` sets the `xs`, `sm` and `md` radii to 0, `round` doubles them.

alg.description: A COSE algorithm identifier, such as -7 (ES256).

DensityChoice.description: The density a user chose. `compact` sets the shorter control heights.

sign_in.description:
The sign-in methods the organization offers, in the order a sign-in screen lists them:
local sign-in first when it is offered, then the outside providers by key. Empty when it
offers none.

DiscoveryTheme.description: The organization's theme, as the apps load it.

stylesheet.description:
The absolute URL of the organization's stylesheet, `<public URL>/theme.css?v=<SHA-256>`,
which is cached for a year; a branding change gives it another hash.

EnrollMethod.description: A local method an enrollment link can set up.

EnrollmentLink.description: An enrollment link, returned once: the only copy of its token.

url.description:
The link to hand to the user. It holds a secret: anyone with it can set up a way to
sign in as the user until it is used, replaced or expires.

EnrollmentStart.description: The token from an enrollment link.

token.description: The text after `#token=` in the link.

EnrollmentStarted.description: What an enrollment link sets up.

email.description: The email the user will sign in with.

methods.description: The methods the organization lets the user set up, passkey first. Never empty.

passkey_options.description:
When `methods` lists `passkey`: the creation options for the passkey, bound to the
sign-in flow whose cookie this answer sets. Finish with `POST
/auth/local/enrollment/passkey` in this browser within 10 minutes.

Entitlements.description: The organization's plan and what it allows: every feature and limit of the server's catalogs.

features.description: Every catalog feature, by key, with whether the plan includes it.

limits.description: Every catalog limit, by key, with the most units the plan allows, or `null` for no limit.

FieldError.description: One rule a request body broke, in a 422's `errors`.

code.description: The stable code of the rule, such as `settings.unknown_key`.

field.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the member that broke the rule, such as `/name`.

GrantScope.description:
A scope a grant or a role assignment applies at: the organization, an account or a course,
by id. An organization scope's `id` is the organization's id.

HealthStatus.description: `ok` when the probe passed, `unavailable` when it did not.

Identity.description: A user's identity as an admin sees it.

attributes.description:
The attributes the provider sent at the latest sign-in, as mapped by the provider's
configuration; `{}` before the first sign-in. Admission rules read them.

provider_key.description: The key of the identity provider.

subject.description: The provider's id for the person, exactly as the provider sends it.

LocalMethods.description: The local sign-in method switches as the organization settings show them.

LocalSignIn.description:
The organization's local sign-in: whether it is on at all, and each method's switch. A method
is offered only when `enabled` and its own switch are both on.

enabled.description: Local sign-in as a whole; off, no local method is offered.

magic_link.description: Sign-in with a link sent by email. Off until the server can send email.

totp.description: A TOTP code as the second step after a password.

appearance.description: The theme and density the user chose (docs/specs/m0/11-app-shell.md B21, Q6).

features.description: The keys of the catalog features the organization's plan includes, sorted.

grants.description:
Each scope where the caller holds at least one effective permission, with those
permissions sorted: the organization first, then accounts by id. A permission held at a
scope also takes effect in every account inside it, which are not listed again.

MeGrant.description: The permissions the caller holds at one scope.

family_name.description: `""` when the identity provider sent none.

given_name.description: `""` when the identity provider sent none.

MyIdentity.description: One of the signed-in user's identities.

provider_key.description: The key of the identity provider.

provider_label.description:
The provider's label, such as "Sign in with Example"; `null` when the provider's
configuration has none.

subject.description: The provider's id for you, exactly as the provider sends it.

MyPasskey.description: One of the signed-in user's passkeys. The credential itself never leaves the server.

last_used_at.description: The last sign-in with it, RFC 3339, UTC; `null` before the first.

MyPasskeyPatch.description: A new name for a passkey.

MyPasskeyStarted.description: The creation options for the browser.

options.description:
Pass `publicKey` to `navigator.credentials.create`, then send the result to `POST
/api/v1/me/passkeys` in this browser within 10 minutes.

parent_id.description: The parent account; you must hold `account.manage` at a scope containing it.

NewIdentity.description: An identity to link to a user, so they can sign in with it the first time.

provider_key.description: The key of one of the organization's identity providers.

subject.description: The provider's id for the person; stored exactly as given, not empty.

name.description: What you call this passkey: trimmed, 1 to 200 characters. `Passkey` when absent.

key.description:
A lowercase letter, then up to 62 lowercase letters, digits or underscores; not the key
of a built-in role or another custom role of the organization.

permissions.description:
Catalog keys (`GET /api/v1/admin/permissions`), each at most once and each held by the
caller at organization scope.

role_id.description:
A built-in role other than `manager` and `observer`, or a custom role of the
organization.

scope.description: The organization (its own id) or an account of it. `course` is not available yet.

NewUser.description: A user to create. The new user is `local` and `active`, and has no local credential.

email.description: Trimmed; at most 254 characters; unique in the organization in any letter case.

external_id.description: At most 200 characters; unique in the organization.

identities.description:
Identities to link to the new user, so they can sign in with them the first time; at
most 20.

locale.description: `en`, the default and the only locale in M0.

tz.description: An IANA time zone; the organization's `default_tz` when omitted.

NewUserIdentity.description: An identity to link to a new user: the provider's subject at the provider with this key.

subject.description: Stored exactly as given; not empty.

NextStep.description: The next step a password sign-in needs.

OrgSettings.description:
Every organization setting with its effective value: the stored one, or the setting's
default when none is stored.

admission.description: Who admission lets in; read-only here, changed through `PUT /api/v1/admin/admission`.

default_tz.description: The IANA time zone a user created without one gets; `UTC` unless set.

email_matching.description:
Whether a sign-in through an identity the organization does not know yet may be linked
to the existing user with the same email address. `false` unless set, and this release
refuses to set it to `true`.

local_sign_in.description:
The local sign-in method switches; read-only here, changed through
`PUT /api/v1/admin/local-sign-in`.

OrgSettingsPatch.description:
A partial change to the organization settings: one optional member per setting this route
writes; only the members present change. A member that is no setting, or a setting another
route writes, is refused.

default_tz.description: An IANA time zone, matched in any letter case and stored in the database's spelling.

slug.description: Fixed when the organization is created.

OrganizationPatch.description:
A change to the organization; an omitted member is left as it is. A member sent as `null`
is malformed: omit it instead.

items.description: An account of the caller's organization.

depth.description: 0 for the root, 1 for its children, and so on; at most 16.

parent_id.description: `null` for the root only. Shown even when the parent is not visible to the caller.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: A built-in role or a custom role of the organization.

builtin.description: Built-in roles are the same in every organization and cannot be changed or deleted.

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants. A built-in role's are this server's list for it.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: A role granted to a user at a scope.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the assignment; `null` for a `local` one.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: A user of the caller's organization.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the user; `null` when there is none.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

PasskeyCreationOptions.description:
`CredentialCreationOptions` as JSON: pass `publicKey` to
`PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON`, then to `navigator.credentials.create`.

PasskeyEnrollment.description: The browser's registration response for an enrollment link.

name.description: What the user calls this passkey: trimmed, 1 to 200 characters. `Passkey` when absent.

token.description: The text after `#token=` in the link.

PasskeyRequestOptions.description:
`CredentialRequestOptions` as JSON: pass `publicKey` to
`PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON`, then to `navigator.credentials.get`.

PasskeySignInFinish.description: The browser's answer to the request options.

PasskeySignInStart.description: The address to sign in with.

email.description: The account's email, in any letter case.

return_to.description: The path on this site to open after signing in; anything else becomes `/`.

PasskeySignInStarted.description: The request options for the browser.

options.description:
Pass to `navigator.credentials.get`, then send the result to `POST
/auth/local/passkey/finish` in this browser within 10 minutes.

PasswordChange.description: The signed-in user's current password and the new one. Never logged.

new_password.description: 12 to 256 characters, not on the common-password list.

PasswordEnrollment.description: The password to set through an enrollment link. Never logged.

password.description: 12 to 256 characters, not on the common-password list.

token.description: The text after `#token=` in the link.

PasswordSignIn.description: An email and password to sign in with. Never logged.

email.description: The account's email, in any letter case.

return_to.description: The path on this site to open after signing in; anything else becomes `/`.

PasswordSignedIn.description: The answer of a right password: the user is signed in, or TOTP's second step is needed.

grantable.description: The scope types at which a role assignment grants it.

PlanRef.description: Which plan the organization runs on and how it got it.

key.description: The plan's key; `unlimited` for a self-hosted organization.

PlanSource.description:
How the organization got its plan: a subscription (`stripe`), granted by the operator
(`grant`), the non-profit plan (`nonprofit`), or the self-hosted `unlimited` plan
(`selfhost`).

Problem.description: The body of every error response (RFC 9457).

detail.description: A sentence for a human reader. Clients branch on `code`, never on this text.

errors.description: On a 422, each rule the body broke.

limit.description:
On `entitlement.limit_reached`, the key of the limit the request would pass, such as
`users`.

max.description: On `entitlement.limit_reached`, the plan's value for that limit.

type.description: `about:blank` until the docs site documents each code.

attestation.description: `none`: the server does not ask which device this is.

excludeCredentials.description: The user's registered passkeys, which the authenticator must not register again.

allowCredentials.description:
The passkeys the account may sign in with. Empty when the address has no account or
the account has no passkey: the answer looks the same either way.

rpId.description: The relying party ID: the instance's host name.

userVerification.description: `required`: the authenticator checks a PIN or biometric.

ReadingFont.description: The reading font: the bundled serif, or the organization's UI font.

id.description: The relying party ID: the instance's host name.

Role.description: A built-in role or a custom role of the organization.

builtin.description: Built-in roles are the same in every organization and cannot be changed or deleted.

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants. A built-in role's are this server's list for it.

RoleAssignment.description: A role granted to a user at a scope.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the assignment; `null` for a `local` one.

RolePatch.description: A change to a custom role; an omitted member is left as it is.

permissions.description:
The role's whole new list, each catalog key at most once. The caller must hold at
organization scope every key it adds and every key it drops.

SavedInputs.description: The saved inputs, every choice made.

ScopeRef.description: The scope a new assignment takes effect at.

ScopeType.description: The kind of scope a permission can take effect at.

SignInKind.description: The protocol of a sign-in method.

SignInMethod.description: One sign-in method the organization offers.

key.description:
`local` for local sign-in; otherwise the provider's key, the `{provider}` of
`/auth/{provider}/start`.

kind.description: What the method speaks. A preset provider is the kind it speaks (`oauth2`).

label.description:
The provider's configured label, such as "Sign in with Example"; `null` when its config
holds none, and always for local sign-in, whose labels are the web app's.

methods.description:
Local sign-in only: the local methods the organization offers. `totp` is the second step
after `password` and is listed only beside it.

return_to.description: The path on this site to open next.

ThemeChoice.description: The theme a user chose. `system` follows the operating system's color and contrast settings.

TotpCode.description: A TOTP code, or a recovery code where one is accepted. Never logged.

code.description:
The 6 digits the authenticator app shows (spaces ignored), or, to sign in or disable
TOTP, one of the recovery codes (`ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNOP`, any letter case).

TotpConfirmed.description: The recovery codes of a confirmed TOTP, shown once.

recovery_codes.description: Ten single-use codes that stand in for a TOTP code when the app is lost.

TotpEnrollment.description: A new TOTP secret, shown once.

otpauth_uri.description: The URI to show as a QR code for the authenticator app.

secret.description: The secret in base32, for typing into the app instead.

UiFont.description: A UI font the instance bundles.

User.description: A user of the caller's organization.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the user; `null` when there is none.

UserAppearance.description: The theme and density the signed-in user's pages are drawn in.

id.description: The user handle, base64url, unpadded: the user's id.

UserPatch.description:
A change to a user; an omitted member is left as it is. A member sent as `null` is
malformed, except `email`, where `null` removes the email.

display_name.description: Trimmed; 1 to 200 characters. Refused for a user an outside source owns.

email.description:
Trimmed; at most 254 characters; `null` removes it. Refused for a user an outside source
owns.

family_name.description: At most 200 characters. Refused for a user an outside source owns.

given_name.description: At most 200 characters. Refused for a user an outside source owns.

status.description:
`suspended` ends every session of the user on its next request; you cannot suspend
yourself.

UserSource.description:
Where the user record came from: made by an admin (`local`), at sign-in through an identity
provider (`idp`), or by the sync API, SCIM or a connector, which own it.

UserStatus.description: Whether a user may sign in.

AccountNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: no account with this id exists in the organization, or you cannot see it. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

AdmissionInvalid.description: `request.invalid`: the change breaks a rule; `errors` lists each one (at most 20), each with a JSON Pointer to the member. `admission.sync_only_unavailable` marks `sync_only` turned on, which this release refuses. `admission.rule_invalid` marks a rule that is not one of the documented forms or breaks a limit; `admission.attribute_unknown` an attribute no provider the list applies to maps; `admission.provider_unknown` a key in `rules.providers` that is not an outside provider of the organization.

AdmissionWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `admission.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the body names a rule list, which applies to every user who signs in through an outside provider, and the caller does not hold every catalog permission at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

AssignmentCreateConflict.description: `role_assignment.exists`: the user already holds the role at the scope. `role.unknown_builtin`: the role is a built-in role of another Stepclimb release.

AssignmentCreateForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.assign` at the scope. `permission.escalation`: the role has a catalog permission the caller does not hold at the scope, counting permissions that take no effect there. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

AssignmentCreateNotFound.description: `user.not_found`: no user of the organization has this id. `role.not_found`: no built-in role and no custom role of the organization has this id. `account.not_found`: the scope names no account of the organization, or one you cannot see. `org.not_found`: the scope names another organization, or the request's organization cannot be determined.

AssignmentDeleteConflict.description: `role.unknown_builtin`: the assignment's role is a built-in role of another Stepclimb release. `role_assignment.externally_managed`: an identity provider, the sync API, SCIM or a connector owns the assignment. `role_assignment.last_org_admin`: it is the organization's last organization-scope Organization admin assignment held by an active user.

AssignmentDeleteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.assign` at the assignment's scope. `permission.escalation`: the role has a catalog permission the caller does not hold at the scope, counting permissions that take no effect there. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

AssignmentDeleteNotFound.description: `role_assignment.not_found`: no assignment of the organization has this id, or its scope is hidden from you. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

AssignmentListNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: the scope filter names no account of the organization, or one you cannot see. `org.not_found`: the scope filter names another organization, or the request's organization cannot be determined.

BadRequest.description: `request.malformed`: the body, a path parameter or a query parameter does not parse or does not match the schema, or `limit` is outside 1 to 200. `pagination.invalid_cursor`: the cursor does not decode.

BrandingInvalid.description: `branding.invalid_input`: an input fails validation; `errors` names it (`branding.invalid_color`, `branding.too_long`, `branding.not_a_choice`). `branding.contrast_failed`: a generated theme has a failing contrast pair; `report` lists every appearance's pairs, failing pairs first.

BrandingWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `branding.manage` at organization scope. `entitlement.feature_unavailable`: the organization's plan does not include `custom_branding`. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

CreateConflict.description: `role.key_taken`: a built-in role or another custom role of the organization has the key.

CreateForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: you hold `account.manage` nowhere, or you can see the parent without holding it there. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

CsrfRefused.description: `auth.csrf_refused`: an unsafe request without a bearer credential did not come from this site: `Sec-Fetch-Site` is not `same-origin`, `Origin` is sent but is not an allowed origin, or neither header is sent.

DeleteConflict.description: `role.builtin_immutable`: built-in roles cannot be deleted. `role.in_use`: the role still has assignments; remove them first.

DeleteForbidden.description: `entitlement.feature_unavailable`: the organization's plan does not include custom roles. `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.manage` at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

DeleteNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: the account does not exist or you cannot see its parent. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

EnrollPasskeyForbidden.description: `auth.suspended`: the account is suspended. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

EnrollPasskeyInvalid.description: `request.malformed`: the body is not `{token, credential, name?}`. `auth.enrollment_invalid`: the link is unknown, already used, replaced by a newer link, or for another organization. `auth.enrollment_expired`: the link is older than its 7-day lifetime. `auth.flow_invalid`: no registration was started in this browser for this link, or it was already finished; open the link again. `auth.flow_expired`: the registration was started more than 10 minutes ago; open the link again. `auth.passkey_invalid`: the passkey's response did not verify, or this passkey is already registered; open the link again and retry.

EnrollPasskeyNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: passkey sign-in is switched off for this organization. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

EnrollPasswordInvalid.description: `request.malformed`: the body is not `{token, password}`. `auth.enrollment_invalid`: the link is unknown, already used, replaced by a newer link, or for another organization. `auth.enrollment_expired`: the link is older than its 7-day lifetime.

EnrollmentLinkConflict.description: `local.email_required`: the user has no email address, which local sign-in finds them by; add one first.

EnrollmentStartInvalid.description: `request.malformed`: the body is not `{token}`. `auth.enrollment_invalid`: the link is unknown, already used, replaced by a newer link, or for another organization. `auth.enrollment_expired`: the link is older than its 7-day lifetime; ask an admin for a new one.

EnrollmentStartNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: the organization offers neither passkey nor password sign-in. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

IdentityDeleteConflict.description: `identity.last_sign_in_method`: the user would be left with no way to sign in. `identity.local`: the identity is the user's local account, which is not removed here.

IdentityDeleteNotFound.description: `user.not_found`: no user of the organization has this id. `identity.not_found`: the user has no identity with this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

IdentityLinkConflict.description: `identity.taken`: this provider's subject is already linked to a user.

IdentityWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `user.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the user holds a permission, at any scope, that the caller does not hold at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

InternalError.description: `internal.error`: the server failed; the cause is in its log.

LocalSignInConflict.description: `local.last_method`: the change would leave the organization no way to sign in: no offered passkey, password or magic link (TOTP is only a second step), and no enabled outside provider.

LocalSignInForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `provider.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the change affects how every user signs in, and the caller does not hold every catalog permission at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

LocalSignInInvalid.description: `request.invalid`: the change breaks a rule; `errors` lists each one. `local.magic_link_needs_email` marks `magic_link` switched on while the server cannot send email.

ManageForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: you can see the account but do not hold `account.manage` at a scope containing it (for a delete, the account's parent). `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MethodNotAllowed.description: `request.method_not_allowed`: the path does not take this method; `Allow` lists the methods it takes.

MoveConflict.description: `account.root_immutable`: the root account cannot be moved. `account.move_into_descendant`: the destination is the account itself or one of its descendants. `account.too_deep`: an account of the moved subtree would end more than 16 levels below the root.

MoveForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: you can see the account's parent but do not hold `account.manage` there. `permission.escalation`: the destination would give you, over the moved account, a permission you do not hold over it now. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MoveNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: the account does not exist or you cannot see its parent, or the destination `parent_id` does not exist or is outside every subtree where you hold `account.manage`. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

MyIdentityDeleteConflict.description: `identity.last_sign_in_method`: you would be left with no way to sign in. `identity.local`: the identity is your local account, which is not removed here. `identity.externally_managed`: an identity provider, the sync API, SCIM or a connector owns your user record and would link the identity again; ask an admin.

MyIdentityNotFound.description: `identity.not_found`: you have no identity with this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

MyPasskeyAddForbidden.description: `auth.session_required`: the request carries a bearer credential; only a signed-in browser session manages passkeys. `local.passkeys_not_allowed`: you have no local account, and no identity provider you sign in with lets its users add a passkey. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MyPasskeyAddInvalid.description: `request.malformed`: the body is not `{credential, name?}`. `auth.flow_invalid`: no passkey registration was started in this browser for you, or it was already finished; start again. `auth.flow_expired`: the registration was started more than 10 minutes ago; start again. `auth.passkey_invalid`: the passkey's response did not verify, or this passkey is already registered; start again and retry.

MyPasskeyDeleteConflict.description: `local.last_method`: this passkey is your last way to sign in. Add another passkey before you delete this one.

MyPasskeyNotFound.description: `passkey.not_found`: you have no passkey with this id. `auth.method_disabled`: passkey sign-in is switched off for this organization. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

MyPasskeyWriteForbidden.description: `auth.session_required`: the request carries a bearer credential; only a signed-in browser session manages passkeys. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MyPasskeysForbidden.description: `auth.session_required`: the request carries a bearer credential; only a signed-in browser session manages passkeys.

MyPasskeysNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: passkey sign-in is switched off for this organization. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

MyPasswordForbidden.description: `auth.session_required`: the request carries a bearer credential; only a signed-in browser session changes a password. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MyPasswordUnauthorized.description: `auth.unauthenticated`, `auth.session_expired`, `auth.suspended`: no valid session. `auth.credentials_invalid`: the current password is wrong.

MyTotpConfirmConflict.description: `local.totp_not_started`: no TOTP enrollment is waiting for a code; start one. `local.totp_enabled`: TOTP is already on.

MyTotpForbidden.description: `auth.session_required`: the request carries a bearer credential; only a signed-in browser session manages TOTP. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MyTotpStartConflict.description: `local.password_required`: the account has no password, which TOTP follows. `local.totp_enabled`: TOTP is already on; disable it first.

MyTotpUnauthorized.description: `auth.unauthenticated`, `auth.session_expired`, `auth.suspended`: no valid session. `auth.totp_invalid`: the code is wrong, already used, or not the current one.

NoOrganization.description: `org.none`: the instance has no organization yet.

OrgWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `organization.manage` at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

OrganizationNotFound.description: `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

ParentNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: no account with `parent_id` exists in the organization, or you cannot see it. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

PasskeySignInFinishBadRequest.description: `request.malformed`: the body is not `{credential}`. `auth.flow_invalid`: no passkey sign-in was started in this browser, or it was already finished; start again. `auth.flow_expired`: the sign-in was started more than 10 minutes ago; start again.

PasskeySignInFinishForbidden.description: `auth.suspended`: the account is suspended. `local.passkeys_not_allowed`: the account has no local account and no identity provider it signs in with allows passkeys, so its passkeys do not sign in. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

PasskeySignInFinishNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: passkey sign-in is switched off for this organization. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

PasskeySignInFinishUnauthorized.description: `auth.passkey_invalid`: the passkey did not sign in: it is not a passkey of the account the sign-in was started for, or its answer did not verify. Start again.

PasskeySignInStartNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: passkey sign-in is switched off for this organization. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

PasswordNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: password sign-in is switched off for this organization. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

PasswordSignInForbidden.description: `auth.suspended`: the account is suspended. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

PasswordSignInUnauthorized.description: `auth.credentials_invalid`: the email and password do not match an account of this organization that has a password.

PasswordWeak.description: `request.invalid` with `local.password_weak` at the password: it has fewer than 12 or more than 256 characters, or it is on the server's list of 10,000 common passwords.

PayloadTooLarge.description: `request.too_large`: the body is larger than the server accepts.

PermissionDenied.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold the operation's permission at a scope containing its target.

RateLimited.description: `auth.rate_limited`: too many sign-in or token requests from this client address, or too many failed password or TOTP checks for this account; `Retry-After` gives the seconds until the limit's window closes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, at least 1.

RoleNotFound.description: `role.not_found`: no built-in role and no custom role of the organization has this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

RouteNotFound.description: `request.not_found`: no API operation has this path.

SettingsInvalid.description: `request.invalid`: the patch breaks a rule; `errors` lists each one. `settings.unknown_key` marks a key that is no organization setting; `settings.read_only` a setting this route does not change (`local_sign_in`: `PUT /api/v1/admin/local-sign-in`; `admission`: `PUT /api/v1/admin/admission`); `tz.unknown` a `default_tz` that is no IANA time zone; `settings.email_matching_unavailable` an `email_matching` of `true`, which this release refuses.

TotpNotFound.description: `auth.method_disabled`: TOTP is switched off for this organization, or password sign-in is, which TOTP follows. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

TotpSignInBadRequest.description: `request.malformed`: the body is not `{code}`. `auth.flow_invalid`: no password sign-in is waiting for a code in this browser, it was already finished, or the password or TOTP changed since; sign in with the password again. `auth.flow_expired`: the password was checked more than 10 minutes ago; sign in with the password again.

TotpSignInForbidden.description: `auth.suspended`: the account is suspended. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

TotpSignInUnauthorized.description: `auth.totp_invalid`: the code is wrong, already used, or not the current one, and it is no unused recovery code. Sign in with the password again.

Unauthenticated.description: `auth.unauthenticated`: no credential, or one that names no session of the organization. `auth.session_expired`: the session passed its idle or absolute expiry. `auth.suspended`: the user is suspended.

UnprocessableEntity.description: `request.invalid`: the body parses but breaks a rule; `errors` lists each one.

UserCreateConflict.description: `user.external_id_taken`: another user of the organization has this external id. `user.email_taken`: another user of the organization has this email, in any letter case. `identity.taken`: one of `identities` is already linked to a user.

UserCreateForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `user.manage` at organization scope. `entitlement.limit_reached`: the organization's plan allows no more users; `limit` and `max` name the limit and its value. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

UserNotFound.description: `user.not_found`: no user of the organization has this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

UserUpdateConflict.description: `user.externally_managed`: an identity provider, the sync API, SCIM or a connector owns the user's names and email; change them there. `user.cannot_suspend_self`: you cannot suspend yourself. `user.email_taken`: another user of the organization has this email, in any letter case. `role_assignment.last_org_admin`: the user is the organization's last active Organization admin.

UserWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `user.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the patch changes `email` or `status` of a user who holds a permission the caller does not hold at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

WriteForbidden.description: `entitlement.feature_unavailable`: the organization's plan does not include custom roles. `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the caller does not hold, at organization scope, a permission the role gains or loses. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.
